_about: SCP stage machine, the single source both sides test against (FRONTEND-BFF-CONTRACT §63.3, PERMISSION-CONTRACT §53; plan docs/plans/2026-10-15-social-content-pipeline.md §4.3). platform-nest loads this file in its stage-machine suites; platform-ui keeps a byte-identical twin (platform-ui/src/lib/scpStageMachine.json, added by the first UI ticket that needs it at runtime) and a test that compares the bytes, the clientHealthGolden.json pattern. Edit this file first, then the twin. Every value here is data: no client or staff names.
rulings: Owner rulings of 2026-10-26 encoded here: SCP-Q2 (creative source per client), SCP-Q9 and SCP-Q18 refined by SCP-Q19 (exactly four social approvers decide: the Social Media and GM lead seats, the owner and the superadmin), SCP-Q11, SCP-Q14 and SCP-Q15 (the monthly boost budget), SCP-Q13 (the client approves the content, the date, the time and the placement), SCP-Q16 (one of the four files through the publisher), SCP-Q17 (an agent acts as the person who asked), SCP-Q5 and SCP-Q20 (the monthly report in the first release, checked and sent only by the four). SCP-Q21 (the four decide a pipeline publish approval directly: systemRules publish_decision), SCP-Q22 (a report's writer may approve it). Nothing is open.

pseudoTargets.deleted: discard soft-deletes the post (deleted_at); it is in no list and reads 404
pseudoTargets.archived: archive sets archived_at; pipeline_status keeps the status it had, the engine status becomes 'archived', and the post leaves every list

portalStatusRefusal: On the portal routes a post the caller may not see is 404 post_not_found, and a visible post outside the action's 'from' is 409 post_not_with_client (not invalid_transition).

phaseRule: phase = phaseOf[status]; for status 'changes', phase = changeCases[the post's (changeBy, changeKind, returnTo)].phase. Equivalently: changeBy 'client' gives client_changes; else returnTo 'final' or changeKind 'design' gives in_production; else brief.

engineStatus.rule: social_posts.status of a pipeline post is written only by the stage machine, in the same UPDATE as pipeline_status: byPipelineStatus, then the first matching override, top to bottom.

actors.officer: the client's officer: social_engagements.owner_id of the post's engagement (Cerbos attribute ownerId, rule member + variables.owns)
actors.copywriter: a holder of the social_copywriter role in the company (Cerbos derived role social_copywriter)
actors.approver: one of the four social approvers (SCP-Q19; the UI mirrors the rule as canLeadSocial): a holder of a live lead seat on the company's Social Media unit or its GM unit (Cerbos attribute approverIds, derived role social_approver_seat), the IAM owner role reaching the company (the perm_* mirrors of the five approver-only actions), or platform_admin (its wildcard). Never manager, company_admin or a social_manager grant. Never the post's author or the client's officer for proofread and approve (the maker/checker DENY), the owner and the superadmin included
actors.seat_approver: the HoD or the GM: a holder of a live lead seat on the company's Social Media unit or its GM unit (approverIds, social_approver_seat); platform_admin also passes through its wildcard. The team's own steps (manage, record_client, boost) and report drafting are the officer's and theirs; the owner holds none of them
actors.designer: creativeSource 'creatives': an assignee of the client-month Creatives request's PM task (Cerbos attribute assigneeIds); creativeSource 'in_team': a holder of the social_designer role (Cerbos derived role social_designer)
actors.client: an active portal contact of the post's client (Cerbos portal action approve_post); for money, a contact with signing capability (approve_spend, SCP-Q14)
actors.recorder: a member of staff recording a decision the client gave outside the portal: the officer or a seat approver (Cerbos record_client); for money, one of the four approvers (social_engagement budget, SCP-Q18, SCP-Q19)
actors.agent: an agent acting for a person (SCP-Q17): the OBO envelope names the person, x-obo-agent names the agent. The principal IS the person, so every check here decides on the person, the maker/checker DENY included; the agent is recorded in activity metadata.via, never decides
actors.automation: an unattended automation or bot principal (users.kind automation or bot): no person behind the call. Refused every new action (403 automation_cannot_act, and a Cerbos EFFECT_DENY); it may read
actors.publisher: the system: the publisher's result through the dispatch path, or the simulator when SOCIAL_SIMULATION_ENABLED is on
actors.company_admin: holds none of the new actions and is not a social approver (SCP-Q19); no grant can make it one. It cannot put a post in a client's plan either: create also needs author or approve
actors.social_manager: a social_manager grant: no pipeline action (SCP-Q19 ends the approver path SCP-Q9 and SCP-Q18 had named); it keeps the module's existing routes

social_report:approve.refusal: 403 (the report routes keep authorize()'s generic 403); also gates sending a report back

actors: client with signing capability on the client

handoffChecks.rule: all ten must-haves are ticked: logo, brand_colours, brand_fonts, contact_info, handle_and_tags, mandatory_words, no_forbidden_claims, price_terms_checked, location_tag, hashtag_set
caption plus hashtags within each placement network's limit (2,200 characters on Instagram)

every rawAssets entry has a source other than 'unknown'

handoffCheckRule: send_to_proofread refuses 409 checks_failed with blockers[] listing every failing handoff check, unless sendAnyway is true with a sendAnywayReason (10 to 500 characters); then the skipped codes, the reason, the actor and the time are appended to skipped_checks and written to the activity. requiredToSend failures are 409 incomplete_post and can never be sent anyway.

boostBudgets.lowering: allowed down to committed (SCP-Q15 ruled); below it is 409 budget_below_committed, checked when proposed, recorded and agreed
